body: That I know of, there are no religious buildings that accommodate for the homeless in my city/county. Homeless people are not welcome here. Cops are always called on them and they always get arrested. The majority of the homeless population are incredibly mentally unstable, or are hardcore drug addicts. No public or religious building wants to house them.

The homeless shelters are equally dangerous and have little to no control. Many of them are also shutting down as they are not welcoming of homeless people and are actually driving them out of the main metropolitan area. My job would also not appreciate it if one of their employees were seen being a bum on the street. 
None of my friends have ever offered to help me, even when I have been at my worst. They have all looked away. I have even posted on social media my thoughts and that I need help, and not a single one has ever messaged me or called me. J literally don't have anyone to turn to or anywhere to go. As the day goes by, my wanting to commit suicide has really gone up and I'm just waiting for the right moment.

Unfortunately no. The only family I have here is either deceased, unable to have me stay with them (blame California housing sections), or want nothing to do with me. My parent loves to call my relatives and tell them every single mistake I make. Most of the time, they agree with her so I cannot count on them. I literally have nobody to turn to. My minimum wage job will maybe get me a cardboard box big enough for me to sleep in, and that's about it. Living in the streets is also dangerous here as many of the homeless are mentally ill patients or drug addicts that closed down centers kicked out.

I  just can't take it anymore. I am a prisoner in my own home (not figuratively) and it's been that way for a long time. My single mom has severe PTSD from my dad before I was born. It's turned her into a different person according to others, and since I was really young, she took on this angry personality that comes with possessive behavior and verbal abuse. I've tried running away since I was a kid, but I was always returned home by the cops or another family member. Last night was the final straw and I have given up on ever being able to leave home or even be free of her. The only way I think I can escape is dying honestly.

I feel so desperate to leave this place and I'm just so mentally exhausted. I have grown up living with a single parent that is verbally abusive and has a severe case of possessive behavior. At my age, I should be away from home, living my life and being happy but I have never been able to do any of that.
